umcPolicy.classification: Default allocation from the June 30, 2026 filed balance sheet; analyst judgments use the published operating-assets-exclusion illustration. NOT a current total-company fair value.
umcPolicy.authorized_award_policy: The up-to-67m new restricted shares authorized at the May 27, 2026 AGM were not issued at June 30, 2026 and are not in the filed share count; future award cost stays in SBC-inclusive operating margins. Set the fraction to 1 for the published conservative illustration.
umcPolicy.minority_reserve_basis: Filed book non-controlling interests at June 30, 2026 (NT$4,051 thousand), Q2 2026 6-K balance sheet. Book value, not an appraisal.
umcPolicy.award_policy: Zero supplemental cash award reserve beyond the separately modeled67m authorized newsharemaximum. Existingrestrictedsharesalreadyissuedandcounted; recurringSBCexpense remains, so legacy/newawardexpense overlap may conservatively reducevalue. Actualissuancedateunverified.
umcPolicy.funding_policy: Reserve sourcedcurrent bankprincipal6402.321m upfront; placeALLnoncurrentbankprincipal11489.924m inyear2, a conservativeearliestbucket allocation ratherthanexactannualcontractschedule. Domesticbondsfollowcontractualdates. No newfinancing/subsidies/portfolio sales.

summary_en: June 30, 2026 filed cash, time deposits, debt, dividend payable, deposits, tax, contract and pension claims, book NCI (NT$4m) and 12,546m outstanding shares; NT$15bn operating cash from the published illustration. The investment portfolio is excluded and unissued 2026 awards are not counted.
summary_zh: 采用2026年6月30日已申报的现金、定期存款、债务、应付股利、存入保证金、税项、合同与退休金债务、非控制性权益账面值（400万新台币）及12,546百万股流通股；经营所需现金150亿新台币取自已发布示例。不计入投资组合，也不计入未发行的2026年奖励股份。
